topics.label: Introduction and Lecture Overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecturer, sets the context within the cancer lecture series, and outlines the primary learning objectives regarding cancer causation.

topics.label: Cancer Etiology: Genetic Basis, Environmental Exposure, and Epidemiology
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish cancer as a genetic and microenvironmental disease while evaluating the relative contributions of endogenous mutations, environmental exposures, and geographic epidemiological patterns.

topics.label: Mechanisms of Carcinogen Action and Tumor Promotion
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the molecular and physiological mechanisms by which diverse agents initiate DNA damage, undergo metabolic activation, or promote malignancy through inflammation and tissue-specific processes.

topics.label: Methods for Detecting Carcinogenicity and Assessing Risk
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics present the experimental, sequencing, and epidemiological methodologies used to identify carcinogen exposure and evaluate carcinogenic risk.
